name: 24-convert-claude-messages-no-sys-prompt
description: convertClaudeMessages with `useSysPrompt` false: nothing is lifted, so `systemPrompt` stays empty and every system turn takes the :253-267 path -- made into a 'user' turn and stripped of its `name`. `charName` is empty on purpose, so the `example_assistant` branch short circuits on `names.charName &&` and the `startsWithGroupName` predicate is never called (a fixture's `names` is plain JSON, so it could not supply that function). The last two turns are both assistant, which is the merge case at :346-353 for a repeated role; a lone 'system' turn at the very end also proves the merge is by role and not by index.
